belief_statement: Preliminary evidence indicates that control odor procedure recognition has inconsistent effects on characteristic operating receiver shape. The evidence base (3 findings, 1 studies) is growing but not yet conclusive.

latent_variables.name: Dose and duration
latent_variables.rationale: Most studies measure presence/absence of control odor procedure recognition, not dose-response curves. Duration and intensity likely matter.
latent_variables.suggested_measure: Parametric variation of intensity and exposure duration

research_needs.question: Does the effect of control odor procedure recognition on characteristic operating receiver shape replicate in a pre-registered RCT?
research_needs.rationale: Current confidence is moderate. A well-powered pre-registered replication would most efficiently resolve the status of this belief.

research_needs.question: What is the dose-response curve for control odor procedure recognition effects on characteristic operating receiver shape?
research_needs.rationale: Dose-response data enables design guidelines with specific thresholds.
